newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 886 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 886 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 886 contracts compared with 1,433 overnight Tuesday.
There were 108 wheat, 476 corn, 258 soybean, five soymeal, three soyoil, five oat, four corn calls and 27 soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 3/4 cent lower to 1/4 higher, corn was 1-1/4 cents lower to one higher and soybeans were 3-1/4 to four cents higher.
